sources.repository_name: git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepCode.git 2 Create and activate a conda environment with Python 3.11. 3 Install dependencies: pip install deepcode-hku 4 Configure the settings and start the service via ./run.sh (The same issue occurs in the Docker environment). 5 Input a test prompt: "Write a test program that displays 'Test Successful'."
